comment: Effect types (GDD 10.1). Events, buildings, technologies and policies apply them with a strength and a duration in years. target: cell, settlement or civilization. stat: what the effect changes (output_percent, movement_blocked, movement_cost, extraction_percent, depopulation_per_mille_per_year, mood, carry_capacity_percent, cold_tolerance_degrees, spoilage_percent). Effects on a civilization with output_percent or mood count for all its settlements; spoilage_percent changes how fast its food spoils (stage 3f).. stacking: sum (strengths add up), replace (the newest wins) or strongest (the largest absolute strength wins). Destruction (GDD 10.1) is an instant action of an event, not a lasting effect.
